title: centaurea axillaris var. ochroleuca
intro: Centaurea axillaris var. ochroleuca, commonly known as Yellow Knob Centaury, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea axillaris var. ochroleuca include wound healing, immune system support, and the potential treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
